description: Offre de transport réseau TAllis (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tallis. liste des arrêts et des horaires des bus du réseau Tallis circulant sur le territoire de la communauté d'agglomération de Lons-le-Saunier (ECLA). Coverage: Tallis. The publisher named on the listing is Tallis. Its keywords include bus, gtfs, bus-arrets-abris-bus-transports, lons-le-saunier. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GTFS. The listing shows 2024-07-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
